Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details how to use Semrush One to measure organic search performance, track keyword rankings and AI visibility (AEO) across platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity, conduct site health audits, and analyse backlink gaps. modules: [MEA] topics: [seo analytics, rank tracking, site auditing] tier: 3 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. seo analytics / Measuring search performance by analyzing keyword volume, search intent (Informational, Navigational, Commercial, Transactional), and Keyword Difficulty (KD). Performing keyword gap and backlink gap analyses against competitors to discover missing ranking opportunities and high-authority link-building targets (like the Food Network). Utilizing topic research tools to discover trending headlines and user questions to build out content planning queues. rank tracking / Monitoring Google search positions and AI visibility over time using Semrush Position Tracking and Domain Overview. Differentiating between traditional SEO rank tracking and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) tracking, which measures how brands appear in AI-generated answers and LLM outputs (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini). Utilizing the AI Visibility toolkit and Brand Performance reports to track LLM sentiment, share of voice, key business drivers, and strategic recommendations. site auditing / Executing technical site health checks using the Semrush Site Audit tool to identify and prioritize critical errors (like 404 broken links returning 4XX status codes) versus warnings. Ensuring site crawlability for both traditional search engines (via robots.txt) and AI bots/LLMs (via llms.txt files).

Look for. The definition of KD (Keyword Difficulty): a percentage metric showing how hard it is to rank for a keyword. The four search intent types: Informational (I), Navigational (N), Commercial (C), and Transactional (T). The definition of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): the practice of optimizing content to appear in AI-generated search answers and LLM chats. The two critical text files for crawlability: robots.txt for Google and llms.txt for AI tools.
